feeds.title: Kitty Hawk Kites » Kite Flying
feeds.description: Join the sport of kite flying and discover a community of like-minded people. Kite experts and the largest selections of stunt kites, kids kites, power kites, kiteboarding kites, and more can be found at Kitty Hawk Kites. Since 1974, Kitty Hawk Kites has grown into the largest kite store in the United States. Join the sport of kite flying and discover a like-minded community.

feeds.title: East Anglian Kite Flyers Blog
feeds.description: Feel the experience of flying kite by exploring the blog section of East Anglian Kite Flyers Blog. The East Anglian Kite Flyers are a small group of kite flyers who live in East Anglia and enjoy flying single-line kites whether they be rigid or soft inflatable kites. Some of our inflatable kites are over 20m in length. Most of our members are from Suffolk or North Essex. We are available to put on kite displays at fetes, outdoor events, and festivals.

feeds.title: Freedom In The Sky
feeds.description: Freedom In The Sky A Kiter's Blog is all about kites. On this blog, we write about the places where we fly, when we fly, and what we fly. We share are personal opinions, about kites, life, and more here.

feeds.title: Great Canadian Kite Company Blog
feeds.description: Explore Great Canadian Kite Company Blog for Latest Updates, News, Information on Kites, Kite Flying, and more. Great Canadian Kite Company has been providing you with quality kites from many of the best kite manufacturers today, Along with kite accessories, parts, service, and after-sale support to help ensure that whether you fly stunt kites, singles lone kites, or parafoil kites, your Kite flying experience is great.

feeds.title: Best Breezes.
feeds.description: Read out articles about Kite Flying, Different Types of Kites, History of Kite Flying on Best Breezes. Bob White is a native of Port Colborne, ON, Canada. His love of kites has extended from childhood right through to the present day. In 2005 Bob began publishing his writing and research about kites on the website Best-Breezes.

feeds.title: Kiting Planet
feeds.description: I created this site as a way for readers to learn more about kites and flying them. As I've traveled the world, I have seen kite festivals and watched unusual kites being flown, and wanted to learn more about them.
